{{Otheruses|Blaze}}
The '''''Rebellion Blaze''''' was an infamous gunboat of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The [[Rebellion Blaze (quadrant)|Rebellion Blaze Quadrant]] in the [[Karthakk system]] was named after this ship.
